# Tests the full Windows suite expects to fail because their data is not available to CI.
# CI now supplies the release bundle's helpers, shadow library and search catalogue, so many of
# these should pass; the compare step lists those, and they are removed here once confirmed.
# The full-tests job fails only when a test NOT listed here fails, and reports listed tests that
# started passing (remove them here). One test name per line; blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# Why they fail (Windows run 2026-11-18, job 135128746949, sources fingerprint 0c531a326454c1dd):
# - ../bench-next (connector/physics Python helpers and test models) is missing: the connector
#   backend dies on `import physics`, so connect/hinge/check/verify calls see "pipe is being closed".
# - spikes/search/out (part search catalogue) is missing: search tests.
# - meshes_match_python: the reference fixture was made with a different LDraw library release than
#   the one CI downloads; the hinge/click parts 30383, 30553, 44301a, 44302a and 44567a differ.
